nodes.title: FL Chatterbox Multilingual TTS

widgets_values:
## Chatterbox multilingual (E40) - text to speech in 23 languages

The **only path to non-English VO** in the audio cell: `FL_ChatterboxMultilingualTTS`
(same pack, `filliptm/ComfyUI_Fill-ChatterBox`) - 23 languages, same expressiveness
knobs as the standard node, cross-lingual voice cloning via `audio_prompt`.

- **`language`** selects the target; the **text must be written in that language**.
- Measured (E40): **Russian words PASS / ears FAIL** - the script comes back
  word-perfect (ASR) but the delivery carries a **heavy foreign accent** (the model is
  English-anchored). **Japanese FAILS the words test** outright - the take does not say
  the script. The "23 languages" list is NOT uniform: verify each new language with a
  transcript, then ears for accent, before trusting it.
- Same output caveats as the standard node: **24 kHz mono**, lands near full scale
  (peak -0.1..-1.9 dBFS measured), normalise before mixing.
- For paralinguistic tags there is **no multilingual Turbo** - Turbo is English-only.

*How to run it: story **S26** in `HOWTO.md`  ·  Why it is this way: **E40** in `audio/EXPERIMENTS.md`.*

**DEMOTED to scratch 2026-11-15 (E40):** Russian words PASS but the ears rejected the delivery - heavy foreign accent, and the errors are stress-level (mis-stressed words shift vowel reduction; the ASR "slip" was a real mispronunciation). Cloning a native reference cannot fix that (a reference supplies timbre, not the model's text-to-phoneme decisions). Japanese fails the words test outright. Polished non-English VO is closed in this pack; rebuild from this file only for a stylised foreign-voice character.
